properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 9 at 9:04PM MST until September 9 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 904 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1
and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is already occurring
with the Babocomari River near Tombstone exceeding bankfull.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Whetstone, Huachuca City, Fairbank and Charleston.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 300 and 313. Route 80 between mile
markers 306 and 313. Route 82 between mile markers 49 and 67.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Slaughter House Wash, Middle Canyon Wash, Babocomari River,
Escalante Wash, San Pedro River, Walnut Gulch, Willow Wash and
Clifford Wash.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 11:51AM CDT until September 10 at 9:00PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 25.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:45 AM CDT Wednesday was 26.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 19.9 feet Monday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.9
feet on 05/20/1994.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
